catalog.method: GET fixed URL; one-line Base64 -> modified XXTEA (delta 0x9A7393B4, key HexXVPNPass padded to 16 bytes) -> JSON UTF-8; text field values that are valid Base64 are further decrypted with Jdecrypt (AES/CBC, key = SHA-256 of native string, fixed IV)
catalog.notes: 9 servers, all Free category, all vless protocol; 434 tweaks; 977 text fields decrypted with Jdecrypt. Endpoint ignores Range (200 + full body); script retries a plain GET on truncation. AR:// is a random export prefix, not an import link; only standard vmess/vless/ss/trojan links, already covered by SP-DECODE core.

dependencies: Python >=3.10; standard library only (pure-Python AES included in the scripts)

files.method: Base64(AES/CBC/PKCS7Padding(profile JSON, key = SHA-256(master key), IV = 16 zero bytes)); master key derived as in the app
files.notes: Profile JSON has 28 fields; protections (password, root block, DeviceID, expiry, Play installer) checked after decryption. Round-trip synthetic 5/5; no real .ar sample exists in the APK assets. No .sks support (excluded).

name: AR PRO VPN
